picks.editorial_note: RPI landing two DOE Genesis Mission Phase I awards — including leading an AI-guided rare-earth materials project with a national lab — signals deep, direct university integration into the federal government's flagship AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: An $874 million Commerce Department commitment to semiconductor R&D directly targets the compute supply chain underpinning AI development nationally, making this one of the largest and most consequential funding actions of the week.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restoring a paralyzed ALS patient's own voice is a striking real-world demonstration of AI's potential to directly restore human capability, not just accelerate research.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope, backed by DOE's Genesis Mission and Fermi Data Platform, marks a genuine scientific first in autonomous astronomical discovery.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5 million NSF AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation, spanning Delaware, Florida, Princeton, and Penn, represents a major multi-institution federal investment in AI-clinician collaboration for rehabilitation and health care.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's AI framework combining thermodynamics with machine learning to predict solid-state reaction pathways could meaningfully speed up how new materials are discovered and synthesized.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's role in CuspAI's global AI Materials Foundry ties a major university into an international, industry-led network for AI-driven materials design and robotic experimentation.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech leading a national Programmable Cloud Laboratory for AI-driven, autonomous materials and manufacturing research establishes it as a hub for a new class of shared scientific infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech to Lead National Cloud Laboratory for Advanced Manufacturing and Materials

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska's $18 million NSF MRSEC award to study ultra-thin quantum materials is a substantial, multi-year federal bet on materials research with implications for future AI hardware efficiency.
picks.title: Husker team earns elite NSF award to drive next generation of materials research

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework, letting generalist and specialist AI models collaborate on disease diagnosis, points to a practical architecture for improving diagnostic accuracy in clinical AI systems.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Novel AI Framework Enabling Efficient Collaboration between Generalist and Specialist Models for Disease Diagnosis
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology
